parsed.name: Rheodyne MXII 多通切换阀
parsed.description: 这是一种电动多通切换阀，用于在多个液路端口之间切换流体通道。实验室中常用于色谱、流动分析及自动化液路系统中的流路选择、样品切换和溶剂导向。该证据表明驱动面向 Rheodyne MXII 系列阀，并已在 MXX778-605 十口阀上测试。
parsed.description_en: This is a motorized multiport valve used to switch fluid flow between multiple ports. In laboratories it is commonly used for flow-path selection, sample switching, and solvent routing in chromatography, flow analysis, and automated fluidic systems. The evidence indicates support for the Rheodyne MXII valve family and testing on the MXX778-605 10-port valve.
